investment_theses.thesis: JPMorgan's 'once in a generation' fixed-income opportunity signals rate-cut cycle is pricing in; buy long-duration fixed-income ETFs and short the USD.
supporting_signals: CNBC: JPMorgan portfolio manager Priya Misra bullish on high-quality credit and willing to take risk
CoinDesk: One-year post-flash-crash liquidity recovery suggests stabilization window for risk-asset rotation
investment_theses.counter_view: Inflation persistence or geopolitical escalation (Yemen, Ukraine, Poland tension) could trigger safe-haven demand and rate hold/hikes instead of cuts.
investment_theses.expression: Long 20+ year Treasury ETF (TLT) or 10Y Treasury futures; short USD Index (DXY) via DXY inverse ETF or short DXY spot

investment_theses.thesis: Record retail margin debt and extreme leverage among unsophisticated traders (living-with-mom cohort) mirrors pre-crash conditions; equity drawdown imminent within 3–6 months.

CoinDesk: Bitcoin volatility plunged but extreme price swings more frequent than 2018—early warning of liquidity fragility

investment_theses.thesis: AI safety evaluation and tokenized asset markets (stocks, commodities) are structural growth vectors; crypto infrastructure and L1 platforms with security differentiation (Tron post-quantum, NEAR, Starknet) will outperform.
